objective: Replace ambiguous historical Semgrep zero-result evidence with pinned, canary-qualified remeasurements while preserving the original artifacts and preventing evidence repair from changing classifier ground truth.

historical_evidence_policy.reason: Each SARIF document reports successful execution and zero results but predates target-count verification and was created while parent/default Git-ignore discovery could select zero snapshot files.

snapshot_tree_digest.construction: SHA-256 of the byte stream produced by sorting snapshot-relative file names, excluding __pycache__ files, and hashing each file with shasum -a 256.
snapshot_tree_digest.purpose: Fail closed if a retained snapshot changes before remeasurement.

pr_sequence: Freeze this inventory and protocol before observing corrected results.
Execute and report the remeasurements in a separate PR.
execution_protocol.precondition: The full production scanner-canaries command must pass immediately before the historical reruns.
required_invocation_controls: --project-root set to the exact retained snapshot

required_deltas: historical target count unknown to corrected target count
historical finding count to corrected finding count
result_contract.raw_retention: Retain raw SARIF and target-report output in the Git-ignored artifact store and commit their SHA-256 digests in the result receipt.
result_contract.failure_policy: Retain and report any failed, partial, unavailable, malformed-output, or zero-target result; do not replace it or narrow the cohort after observing results.

isolation.unmatched_candidates: Report counts and preserve raw output only.
isolation.evaluation_claim: Execution remeasurement only; no recall, precision, or vulnerability-prevalence claim.

success_criteria: All three original artifacts remain byte-for-byte unchanged and visibly classified as coverage-invalid.
Every retained snapshot matches its frozen tree digest before scanning.
The production deployment canary passes before any rerun.
Every rerun uses the pinned configuration and exposes a verified nonzero target count or an attributable non-clean status.
The committed result receipt reports all statuses and candidate deltas, including failures and zeros.
No rerun candidate enters labels, ground truth, classifier scoring, or the human-review pool.
